senses.gloss: f., pl. עוֹלְלָן, עוֹלְלָתָא = h. עוֹלֵלוֹת (v. עוֹלֵלָה) gleanings, single bunches.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 49:9">Targ. Jer. XLIX, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Obadiah 1:5">Targ. Ob. I, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 17:6">Targ. Is. XVII, 6</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>עוֹלְלִין</he> m.).—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 22</cite> (ref. to <he>ועולל</he> <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">ib.</cite>) <he>קטיף עוֹלְלָתֵיהוֹן כמה דקטפת עוֹלְלָתַי</he> cut their last bunches as thou hast done to mine; v. <cite ref="P00264"><he>עוֹלֵלָה</he></cite>.
